module: Resolution of references between jbeam rows. In a jbeam file, a column whose name contains ':' (e.g. "id1:", "torqueArm:", or "links:") designates the name of a row in another section (nodes by default if nothing follows the colon, e.g. "nodeArm:"; "id1:nodes" explicit). This module finds these links (prepareLinksDestructive), replaces them with the numeric identifier cid of the target (resolveLinks), and handles the group links "[group]:section" which become the list of cids of the rows belonging to those groups (resolveGroupLinks). This is why beams reference their nodes by number in the final data.
notes: Three forms of links: (a) row column 'name:section' = string value, replaced by the cid of the target (the key 'name:section' is removed and the column 'name' receives the cid); (b) column whose value is a table (list of names), each element is replaced by a cid; (c) section key 'name:section' with a list of names (e.g. torqueReactionNodes:) renamed 'name_section'.
sectionRenames (e.g. triggers2 -> triggers) is applied to the target section names.

When a target is not found: warning in the log unless the row carries optional = true (or the key is part of an internal list of optional links such as torqueArm:, nodeArm:, nodeCoupling:...), and the row is removed from its section (entry[rowKey] = nil).
A non-existent target section causes a warning and the link data is dropped.
resolveLinks also reindexes each section declared in vehicle.validTables by cid; vehicle.validTables must therefore exist.

resolveGroupLinks: the column '[g1,g2]:nodes' (group field name in brackets) is replaced by a key '_<field>_<section>' containing the list of cids of the rows whose group field matches; a group field of type string is turned into a list of one string.

prepareLinksDestructive.desc: Walks all the vehicle's sections, detects the links, removes the link keys from the rows (modifies vehicle in place) and returns a flat journal of triplets (row or list, key, target row) so that resolveLinks writes the cids.

returns.desc: Flat list of triplets {container, key, targetRow, ...} (indices 1,2,3 then 4,5,6...).

resolveLinks.desc: Writes the cid of its target into each link then rebuilds the sections of vehicle.validTables by indexing them by cid.

resolveGroupLinks.desc: Replaces the '[group]:section' columns with lists of cids of rows belonging to the cited groups (key '_group_section').
